title: Cover Farside ETF live scoring collector integration
instructions: Add ONE deterministic focused live run_once integration regression for the already-registered FarsideEtfCollector. Create only the allowed new test file. Use a fixed two-row Farside HTML table (14 Aug 2026 and 17 Aug 2026, each with a Total cell; latest 17 Aug Total 137.3) and fixed as_of_ms of 2026-08-18T12:00:00Z. Monkeypatch runner.FarsideEtfCollector to a no-network stub whose collect(observed_at_ms, include_backfill) delegates to FarsideEtfCollector.parse_html on that HTML; monkeypatch ALL other default live collector classes in runner._collect_live to EmptyCollector returning (), including IbitHoldingsCollector, BitmexReserveCollector, MempoolMinerNetworkCollector, StrategyTreasuryCollector, AmericanBitcoinTreasuryCollector, DefiLlamaStablecoinCollector, DefiLlamaStablecoinCompositionCollector and CircleUsdcCirculationCollector. Invoke runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=True, include_backfill=False, as_of_ms=fixed). Assert farside_etf collection attempt status OK and observation_count 1; archive contains exactly one ETF net_flow_usd observation from farside_btc_etf with effective_at_ms=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z, available_at_ms=observed_at_ms=fixed, and no context_only provenance flag; archive_records_loaded=1 and scoring_records_loaded=1. Assert handoff families.etf scoring_observation_count=1, context_observation_count=0; source_evidence entry farside_btc_etf has role scoring and correct latest effective/available clocks; evidence_health.collection.successful_collectors includes farside_etf and evidence_health.families.etf has visible_observation_count=1, scoring_observation_count=1, scoring_missing=False, scoring_latest_effective_at_ms=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z, scoring_latest_available_at_ms=fixed, scoring_effective_age_seconds>0 and scoring_availability_age_seconds=0. Preserve existing scoring logic, provider contracts, context-only exclusions, and scoring-only freshness; do not modify production code or other tests. Do not call real networks or require secrets.
